version-spec.create: @echo off set TAG={$$$ version $$$} git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/%TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin %TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git tag %TAG% git push origin main --tags exit /b 0 :exists echo ERROR: tag %TAG% already exists - run -vinc first exit /b 1

meta.description: SQL stores for quevu in Go, on dbh: one module with a common package (the table, writing batches, reading by position, a stored-data provider and a history aggregator) and one package per database that holds its driver (SQLite, MySQL; PostgreSQL to come). Each gives a persistent writer and a provider usable as immediate or historical. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/quevu-sql and its packages qsql, qsqlite, qmysql.
